name: monitoring--prometheus-health-check
description: Prometheus health check validates all scrape targets are healthy and metrics are being collected

implementation.change: Add healthcheck to Prometheus service: curl -f http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1

checks: Prometheus /api/v1/targets returns all targets with state=up
All three scrape jobs (litellm, headroom, qdrant) have scrape_state=success
No scrape_duration_seconds errors in target list
Prometheus /metrics endpoint accessible and returns Prometheus metrics
Container health status is healthy after all targets connect

disabled_reason: Merged into eval 010 (prometheus-dns-targets-with-health): Health check is part of the unified DNS + health configuration.
